note: Hebrew el-hachomesh was once derived from chamesh "five", hence "fifth rib"; it is now understood as the belly or abdomen (also 3:27, 4:6, 20:10).

kjv: unless thou hadst spoken, surely then in the morning the people had gone up every one from following his brother
mine: if you had not spoken, the troops would not have given up pursuing their brothers until morning
note: The Hebrew (mehabboqer na`alah ha`am) is terse: either Abner's appeal now ends a pursuit that would have lasted till morning, or Abner's earlier challenge (2:14) caused the fight; the KJV's literal rendering leaves the sense unclear.
